usageNote: These are independently recorded wildlife observations, not recordings of AVES-operated tours. Field recordings may include ambient sounds or other birds. The photograph and sound accompanying a species may have been recorded in different places. Preserve the attribution and licence links on the public credits page.
verificationNote: Species identity and each sound's own licence were checked against the original iNaturalist API records. All observations were research grade when checked. MP3 duration metadata was readable locally; this does not replace listening and browser playback checks.
